verifications.claim: WWE filed for "Club WWE" on March 27, 2026, for entertainment services.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: 'submitted the paperwork... on March 26, 2026'; R3: 'On March 27, WWE filed to trademark “Club WWE.”'; services: 'Membership club services in the nature of providing discounts and special offers... Advertising services...' (no mention of entertainment services)
verifications.reasoning: Date varies between sources (March 26 vs. 27); services described as membership club/discounts/advertising, directly contradicting 'entertainment services'.

verifications.claim: A "Club WWE" sticker/logo appeared during SmackDown programming.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'multiple visual references to the branding during the March 27 broadcast. A logo... flashed on the screen... a person carried a physical sign bearing the design back and forth in view of the hard cam.'
verifications.reasoning: Directly describes logo and physical sign/sticker during SmackDown.

verifications.claim: The O.C. (Original Club) consisted of AJ Styles, Luke Gallows, Karl Anderson, and Michin.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'The Club aka The O.C.... consisting of AJ Styles, Karl Anderson & Luke Gallows and Michin.'; R6: 'composed of leader AJ Styles, Luke Gallows, Karl Anderson and Michin.'
verifications.reasoning: Exact membership listed in multiple sources; '(Original Club)' aligns with 'O.C.' derivation from Bullet Club origins.

verifications.claim: Bálor Club is a faction led by Finn Bálor.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R2: Title 'The Bálor Club' and snippet 'The Bálor Club was a,, Luke Gallows & Karl Anderson.'; R6: 'former Bullet Club leader Finn Bálor'
verifications.reasoning: Page title and snippet imply Bálor Club existence with Gallows/Anderson, but no explicit statement 'led by Finn Bálor'; R6 notes Bálor as Bullet Club leader.

verifications.claim: Bálor Club often featured Gallows and Anderson.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: snippet 'The Bálor Club was a,, Luke Gallows & Karl Anderson.'
verifications.reasoning: Directly associates Gallows and Anderson with Bálor Club.

verifications.claim: Bullet Club stable was initially formed in New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW).
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: R4/R6: 'Bullet Club... previous members of, before... departed NJPW'; R5: 'Debut May 19, 2013... Promotions WWE' with WWE-context formation story.
verifications.reasoning: R4/R6 support NJPW origins; R5 contradicts by framing formation in WWE context despite same debut date.

verifications.claim: Many members of Bullet Club later joined WWE.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'Styles... Anderson and Gallows... departed NJPW... for WWE'; R5: lists AJ Styles, Gallows, Anderson, Finn Bálor, etc. as members; R6: 'Styles, Gallows and Anderson... reunited in WWE'; multiple named transitions.
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources confirm numerous Bullet Club members (Styles, Gallows, Anderson, Bálor, etc.) joined WWE.
